lines.subtitle: Two days after Emberfall, the Bishop of Shadow went north.
lines.text: Two days after Emberfall, the Bishop of Shadow went north.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: Cold in here. You should let Vessa redecorate. She's very keen on fire.
lines.text: Cold in here. You should let Vessa redecorate. She's very keen on fire.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: You sent knives after her in the night, and missed. You call that a visit?
lines.text: You sent knives after her in the night, and missed. You call that a visit?

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: Your lake holds the second relic. She'll come for it. Help me stop her.
lines.text: Your lake holds the second relic. She'll come for it. Help me stop her.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Ice does not march for your mistakes, Bishop.
lines.text: Ice does not march for your mistakes, Bishop.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: Not mistakes. Opportunities. Just until the relics are in sensible hands.
lines.text: Not mistakes. Opportunities. Just until the relics are in sensible hands.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: No. My lake stays out of your war.
lines.text: No. My lake stays out of your war.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: And hear me: some doors under Crown Hollow are closed for a reason.
lines.text: And hear me: some doors under Crown Hollow are closed for a reason.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: For now, then. Doors are only closed until someone opens them.
